Welcome back to Work and Wellness. Today's topic is travel. When you travel for work, your routine disappears. You sleep in a new bed, you eat at restaurants, and the meetings never end. So, here are three simple tips. First, keep one small habit from home. For example, a ten-minute workout in your hotel room. Second, walk. Walk to your meetings when you can. And third, protect your sleep. Sleep is the best recovery there is. A short routine is better than no routine. See you next week.

Good evening, and welcome to the Hotel Duomo in Milan. We hope you enjoy your stay. Our gym is on the first floor, and it is open from six in the morning to ten at night. Every day at seven in the morning, there is a free yoga class by the pool. Our restaurant serves breakfast from six thirty to ten thirty. On Sunday, the spa is free for all our guests. If you need anything, please call the reception. Have a relaxing evening.
